description: Pro-Diab HIS — Hoat dong nguoi dung & san pham. Muc dich CHINH la phan tich san pham/UX (chuc nang nao dung nhieu/it, nguoi dung nao gap kho khan o dau), khong chi de debug ky thuat. Nguon du lieu: Properties.UserId/UserEmail/RoleCodes/RequestPath/StatusCode duoc EnrichDiagnosticContext gan vao moi dong log qua UseSerilogRequestLogging (xem backend/src/ProDiabHis.Api/Program.cs). CHI co du lieu cho request cua user DA DANG NHAP (request anonymous nhu /healthz, /api/v1/auth/login truoc khi co token se khong co UserId).

panels.title: Hoat dong theo user (so request / gio)
panels.description: Xu huong su dung theo tung nguoi dung (UserEmail) theo thoi gian — phat hien tai khoan hoat dong bat thuong (spike dot bien) hoac nguoi dung it hoat dong (co the can ho tro/dao tao them).

panels.title: Top chuc nang duoc dung nhieu nhat (7 ngay)
panels.description: Xep hang TOAN BO endpoint theo tan suat goi trong 7 ngay gan nhat — nhin duoc buc tranh toan dien chuc nang nao dung nhieu (uu tien toi uu hieu nang/trai nghiem) va chuc nang nao it dung (co the do kho dung, UX chua tot, hoac khong can thiet — can xem xet cai thien hoac loai bo).

panels.title: Xu huong su dung theo function (theo tuan)
panels.description: So sanh xu huong tang/giam luot goi cua tung endpoint theo thoi gian (khoang rong 30 ngay, buoc 1 ngay) — dung de phat hien chuc nang dang tang truong (uu tien dau tu) hay dang giam dan (tim hieu ly do: doi UX, loi, hay nguoi dung chuyen sang cach khac).

panels.title: Loi 4xx/5xx theo user + function
panels.description: Log stream chi tiet request LOI (>=400) — moi dong da co san Properties.UserEmail/UserId/RequestPath/StatusCode (xem trong noi dung JSON). Tra cuu nhanh khi user bao loi ('toi bi loi luc kham benh nhan X'): dung o tim kiem cua panel de loc theo email, xem ngay ho gap loi o chuc nang nao, may lan, gan nhat luc nao. Bao gom CA 400 (validation that bai — thuong la dau hieu form/UX kho dien dung, khong chi la bug backend). Loki logs panel khong ho tro toan hang truc tiep tu JSON — neu can bang tong hop dang cot rieng (User | Endpoint | So loi), dung Grafana Explore + "Transform > Extract fields" tren cung query nay, huong dan trong docs/ops/log-monitoring-loki-grafana.md.

panels.title: Ty le loi theo function (4xx + 5xx, 24h)
panels.description: Ty le loi tren tong so request cua tung endpoint — tin hieu chat luong/UX: function nao ty le loi cao co the dang gay kho chiu cho nguoi dung (form kho dien dung -> nhieu 400, chuc nang khong on dinh -> nhieu 500), can uu tien xem xet cai thien truoc, khong chi vá bug.

panels.title: Hoat dong theo role (24h)
panels.description: Breakdown so request theo VAI TRO (RoleCodes) thay vi tung ca nhan — huu ich hon cho quyet dinh cai thien san pham: vai tro nao dang su dung he thong nhieu nhat/gap kho khan nhieu nhat (vd le_tan goi API nhieu gap doi bac_si -> uu tien toi uu UX man hinh tiep don).
